statutory_violations.statutory_reference: Model Tenancy Act, 2021, Section 11: Security deposit for residential premises shall not exceed two months' rent and must be refunded to the tenant within one month of vacating after agreed deductions.
statutory_violations.violation_type: Direct Statutory Breach / Unfair Contract Term
statutory_violations.impact: extends your obligation / wait by 60 days
statutory_violations.remedy:
Re: Objection to Unlawful Extension of Security Deposit Refund Window

Dear Landlord,

I am in receipt of the revised Tenancy Agreement. Clause 5 seeks to extend the refund timeline for my security deposit to 90 days.

Please note that under Section 11 of the Model Tenancy Act, 2021, the statutory deadline for refunding the security deposit after vacant possession is strictly 30 days (one month). Furthermore, imposing an unreasonable 90-day retention constitutes an 'Unfair Contract' under Section 2(46) of the Consumer Protection Act, 2019.

I request you to amend this clause back to the statutory limit of 30 days prior to execution. Failing this, I reserve the right to report this deviation to the jurisdictional Rent Authority under Section 30 of the Model Tenancy Act.

Yours sincerely,
[Tenant Name]
